{{Quote|The Republic nationalized Czerka Corporation, assuming ownership of all assets, properties, and, most notably, outstanding debts. I, however, represent Czerka Interstellar; a legally distinct entity which, by pure coincidence, is largely comprised of the former Czerka Corporation leadership and staff.|[[Trey Adelair]]|<ref name="TOR:EO">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Imperial|Evolving Opportunities|Onderon}}</ref>}}
'''Czerka Interstellar''' was a company formed by the former leadership and staff of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] after the company was nationalized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TOR:EO" /> in [[3638 BBY]]<ref name="TOR_updates-2.3">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> at the time of the [[Seizure of CZ-198|crisis]] on [[CZ-198]].<ref name="TOR:ToI">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Titans Of Industry|the ''Ziost Shadow''}}</ref> A legally distinct entity from Czerka Corporation,<ref name="TOR:EO" /><ref name="TOR:THoCR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Height of Corporate Responsibility|Onderon}}</ref> Interstellar was able to operate due to several loopholes in Republic law.<ref name="TOR:EO" /> Czerka Interstellar used the same logo as the Czerka Corporation.<ref name="TOR:TTNoP">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|The Troubling Nature of Progress}}</ref>

During the [[Third Galactic War]], Czerka Interstellar maintained the [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="TOR:EO" /><ref name="TOR:THoCR" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Czerka Interstellar had reformed again into Czerka Corporation.<ref name="SGtD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|157|Czerka Corporation}}</ref><ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
{{Company-stub}}
